# Vendored sprite helpers

The three Python files in this directory were copied from the Codex bundled
`game-studio` sprite pipeline so this skill does not depend on that plugin's
installation path. The source bundle did not contain a separate license file
for these scripts; no license text has been invented or substituted here.

The main deskpet workflow uses `../build_sprite_assets.py`. The vendored files
remain available for single-strip canvas preparation, normalization, and
contact-sheet rendering when those lower-level operations are useful.
